name: Optimism infinite ETH bug (Geth fork)
rootCause: Optimism's l2geth stored ETH balances as an ERC20 and failed to zero them on SELFDESTRUCT, letting a contract duplicate its balance repeatedly. Reported by saurik (Jay Freeman) for a $2M bounty and patched before exploitation.
